gloss: compact car; small car; subcompact vehicle

definitions.gloss: compact car; small car; subcompact vehicle

examples.japanese: {小型車|こがたしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{燃費|ねんぴ}→燃費：18969_nenpi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Compact cars have good fuel economy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{小型車|こがたしゃ}にした。

examples.english: In Japan, because roads are narrow, compact cars are popular and account for the majority of vehicle sales.

notes:
Refers to small passenger vehicles, generally with an engine displacement of 660cc to 2000cc. In Japan's vehicle classification system, {小型車|こがたしゃ} occupies the middle category between ⟦{軽自動車|けいじどうしゃ}→軽自動車：14298_keijidousha⟧ (kei cars, 660cc and under) and ⟦{普通車|ふつうしゃ}→普通車：20940_futsuusha⟧ (standard/full-size cars).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小型車|こがたしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}する→運転する：20318_untensuru⟧: to drive a compact car
- {小型車|こがたしゃ}⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧: compact car-only parking
- {小型車|こがたしゃ}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: license for small vehicles
- {小型車|こがたしゃ}⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧: compact car class (for rentals)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軽自動車|けいじどうしゃ}→軽自動車：14298_keijidousha⟧: kei car (even smaller; 660cc max engine; yellow license plate in Japan)
- ⟦{普通車|ふつうしゃ}→普通車：20940_futsuusha⟧: standard car (larger; white license plate)
- ⟦コンパクト→コンパクト：10862_konpakuto⟧⟦カー→カー：00130_kaa⟧: compact car (loanword; used in marketing and casual speech)
- {大型車|おおがたしゃ}: large vehicle (trucks, buses)
